binary64_rounding.explanation: At 1.0, the upward binary64 spacing is 2^-52, so 2^-54 is below half an ulp and the binary64 addition 1+2^-54 rounds to 1. The precision difference becomes zero; adding the prepared-minus-old term leaves -2^-54.
binary64_rounding.producer_relationship: Fortran sets t_after32=REAL(REAL(t_before32,real64)+Dold64,real32); the R32 rounded result equals t_before32.
binary64_rounding.rounding: IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even under pinned Intel strict FP profile

question_tested: Can the stated sequential R64 residual/precision/diffusion correction leave a signed residual when t_after32 is the ordinary R32-rounded sum of t_before32 and Dold64, coupled_before32 equals t_before32, Dprepared is zero, and other non-diffusion residual is zero?
scope_limits: The primary case is manufactured but uses a consistent ordinary R32 rounded-addition relationship for t_after32.
It demonstrates a possible negative source residual; the prepared endpoint remains 1 and the resulting donor stays positive.
A separate earlier zero-endpoint case is preserved as historical but did not establish the producer relationship.
No D3/C9/C10/C11 runtime bits are used. This does not establish that C11 reaches the state or identify the actual C10 native cause.
No physics source, model code, or native instrumentation was changed.
